services.desc: Pricing is for ages 2+ and dogs. NO ONE UNDER THE AGE OF 2 IS ALLOWED TO TUBE. No discounts on holidays or special events. All tubers 13 and under must wear a life jacket. Weight limit of 250lbs max. This includes, the rental of your tube for one trip down, a life jacket, a hook-up strap, free shuttle ride, restrooms and changing rooms. This is a cash price. Using a credit card online or in person will incur a 4% price increase. Last River Shuttle/Bus to the Upper River location to (Enter River) is at 4:30 pm. Located at 9917 Hwy 17 N.
